description:
The BENETEAU Gran Turismo 45 Open combines dynamic outdoor living with refined comfort below deck.
Available with either inboard or outboard propulsion, it adapts effortlessly to different cruising styles, whether for exhilarating day trips, weekend escapes, or extended stays on board.

sections.title: Exterior Design
sections.intro:
The Gran Turismo 45 Open combines dynamic styling with versatile outdoor living spaces, creating the perfect setting for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying life on the water. A sleek T-top shelters the helm and outdoor galley, while optional aft cockpit covers featuring a telescopic Webasto canopy provide additional protection when required. Opening roof panels bring extra light and fresh air into the cockpit, with manual operation fitted as standard and electric operation available as an option.
At the bow, a U-shaped lounge converts into a generous sunbathing area with the addition of a cushion, while an optional electrically adjustable table enhances its versatility throughout the day. Aft, the spacious cockpit features opposing seating and a pivoting backrest that transforms the area into an additional sunpad, creating a flexible space for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying time on the water.
On the inboard version, a hydraulic swim platform raises and lowers to provide easy access to the water and simplify the launch and recovery of water sports equipment.

sections.title: Interior Design
sections.intro:
The Gran Turismo 45 Open welcomes you into a refined living space designed to balance comfort, versatility, and the pleasures of life on board.
On the main deck, the three-seat helm station sits alongside an outdoor galley, creating a seamless connection between navigation and socialising. A sink is fitted as standard, while an optional grill and multi-mode fridge/freezer elevate the experience of entertaining and dining outdoors.
Below deck, the forward lounge provides a welcoming retreat for relaxation. An electric table allows the seating area to be converted into a comfortable double berth when required, adding greater flexibility for overnight stays. Depending on the selected specification, a television, microwave and refrigerator further enhance onboard comfort and convenience
A choice of two aft accommodation layouts allows you to tailor the interior to your preferred cruising style. The Cabin version features a fully enclosed owner's cabin, providing enhanced privacy and comfort for extended stays on board. Alternatively, the Lounge version creates a more open and versatile living space, with an aft sofa that can be configured to provide individual berths when required.
Completing the lower-deck accommodation, the bathroom features a separate shower, delivering the comfort and convenience needed for extended stays on board.

items.title: Choice of Propulsion
items.text:
Freedom starts with choice. Select from twin Volvo Penta inboard engines rated at 440 or 480 hp, or triple Mercury outboards delivering 350 or 425 hp.
Joystick control is available across the range, ensuring smooth and intuitive manoeuvring in every configuration.

items.title: A Hydraulic Swim Platform
items.text: Available on the inboard version, the hydraulic swim platform creates a seamless connection with the water, making boarding, swimming and handling water sports equipment effortless.

items.title: Two Interior Layouts
items.text:
Whether you prefer the privacy of a dedicated owner's cabin or the versatility of an open lounge, the Gran Turismo 45 Open offers a choice of aft layouts to match your boating lifestyle.
Both configurations retain the same comfortable forward living area, ensuring an inviting atmosphere below deck.

items.title: Distinctive Alpine Edition
items.text: The Alpine Edition stands out with exclusive styling details, including a white hull, black T-top and deck fittings, bespoke upholstery, a black galley worktop, an Alpine steering wheel and a carbon-fibre instrument console.

sections.title: A connected boat
sections.intro: The mobile application, Seanapps, and its onboard unit lets you view the status of the boat's various systems (battery charge, fuel or water tank levels, maintenance scheduling) via your smartphone, as well as planning your route or reviewing your sailing status using your mobile phone.
